title: limonium carolinianum
intro: Limonium carolinianum, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to the coastal regions of the southeastern United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation, promote relaxation, and alleviate anxiety and stress. The health benefits of Limonium carolinianum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
